questions.text: प्राकृतिक संख्या n के लिए, 6ⁿ का अंतिम अंक है :
questions.text_english: For any natural number n, 6ⁿ ends with the digit :
questions.solution: 6 raised to any natural number power always ends in 6. For example, 6¹ = 6, 6² = 36, 6³ = 216, 6⁴ = 1296 — the units digit is always 6. This is because 6 × 6 = 36, and multiplying any number ending in 6 by 6 always gives a product ending in 6. Options A (0), C (3), and D (2) are incorrect as no power of 6 ends in these digits.

questions.text: y = f(x) का ग्राफ दिया गया है। f(x) के शून्यकों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The graph of y = f(x) is given. The number of zeroes of f(x) is :
questions.image_description: A graph of y = f(x) is shown on an XY-plane. The curve crosses the x-axis at exactly 2 points — once on the left side of the origin and once on the right side, forming a wave-like shape.
questions.solution: The number of zeroes of a polynomial f(x) equals the number of times its graph crosses or touches the x-axis. From the given graph, the curve crosses the x-axis at exactly 2 points. Therefore, f(x) has 2 zeroes. Option A (0) is wrong as the graph clearly intersects the x-axis. Option B (1) and D (4) do not match the number of intersection points shown.

questions.text: यदि दो चरों में रैखिक समीकरणों का एक युग्म दो संपाती रेखाओं द्वारा निरूपित किया जाता है, तो समीकरणों के युग्म का/के :
questions.text_english: If a pair of linear equations in two variables is represented by two coincident lines, then the pair of equations has :

options.D: अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं

questions.solution: When two linear equations represent coincident lines, they are essentially the same line — every point on one line lies on the other. This means there are infinitely many points of intersection, giving an infinite number of solutions. Option A (unique solution) applies to intersecting lines, option B (two solutions) is not valid for linear systems, and option C (no solution) applies to parallel lines.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text_english: The common difference of the AP : √2, 2√2, 3√2, 4√2, ..... is :
questions.solution: The common difference of an AP is found by subtracting any term from the next term. Here, 2√2 − √2 = √2. Similarly, 3√2 − 2√2 = √2. So the common difference is √2. Option B (1) is wrong as the terms are multiples of √2. Option C (2√2) and D (−√2) are incorrect as the sequence is increasing with equal gaps of √2.

questions.text: यदि △ABC और △DEF समरूप हैं, जहाँ 2AB = DE और BC = 8 cm, तो EF बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If △ABC and △DEF are similar such that 2AB = DE and BC = 8 cm, then EF is equal to :
questions.solution: Since △ABC ~ △DEF, their corresponding sides are in proportion: AB/DE = BC/EF. Given 2AB = DE, so DE/AB = 2, meaning the ratio of similarity is 2. Therefore EF/BC = 2, giving EF = 2 × BC = 2 × 8 = 16 cm. Options A, B, and C do not correctly apply the scale factor of 2.

questions.text: बिन्दुओं (5, −4) और (6, 4) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य बिन्दु स्थित है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment joining the points (5, −4) and (6, 4) lies on :

options.D: न x-अक्ष न ही y-अक्ष पर

questions.solution: The midpoint of two points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2). Here midpoint = ((5+6)/2, (−4+4)/2) = (11/2, 0) = (5.5, 0). Since the y-coordinate is 0, the midpoint lies on the x-axis. It does not lie on the y-axis (which requires x = 0), nor at the origin (which requires both coordinates = 0).

questions.text: यदि sin θ = a/b दिया गया है, तो cos θ बराबर है :
questions.text_english: Given that sin θ = a/b, then cos θ is equal to :
questions.solution: Using the identity sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, we get cos²θ = 1 − sin²θ = 1 − a²/b² = (b²−a²)/b². Therefore cos θ = √(b²−a²)/b. Option A is the reciprocal of cos θ (i.e., sec θ). Option B is cot θ and option D is tan θ in terms of the given values.

questions.text: यदि cos A = 1/2 है, तो sin²A + 2cos²A का मान है :
questions.text_english: If cos A = 1/2, then the value of sin²A + 2cos²A is :
questions.solution: Given cos A = 1/2, so cos²A = 1/4. Using sin²A = 1 − cos²A = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4. Therefore sin²A + 2cos²A = 3/4 + 2(1/4) = 3/4 + 2/4 = 5/4. Wait — let me recheck: 3/4 + 1/2 = 3/4 + 2/4 = 5/4. However, we can also write sin²A + 2cos²A = sin²A + cos²A + cos²A = 1 + 1/4 = 5/4. The correct answer is 5/4, which is option B.

questions.text: एक उड़ रही पतंग की डोरी भूमि पर एक बिन्दु से बाँधी गई है। पतंग और भूमि पर उस बिन्दु के बीच डोरी की लंबाई 80 मीटर है। डोरी भूमि से 30° का कोण बनाती है। भूमि से पतंग की ऊँचाई है :
questions.text_english: The string of a flying kite is tied to a point on the ground. The length of the string between the kite and the point on the ground is 80 m. The string makes an angle of 30° with the ground. The height of the kite above the ground is :
questions.solution: The height of the kite = string length × sin(30°) = 80 × 1/2 = 40 m. The string is the hypotenuse of a right triangle and the height is the opposite side to the 30° angle. Since sin 30° = 1/2, height = 80 × 1/2 = 40 m. Options A, C, and D incorrectly use √3 which would arise from sin 60° or tan 60°, not sin 30°.

questions.text: यदि केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर बाह्य बिन्दु T से दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ TP और TQ इस प्रकार हैं कि ∠POQ = 120°, तो ∠PTQ बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If TP and TQ are two tangents to a circle with centre O from an external point T so that ∠POQ = 120°, then ∠PTQ is equal to :
questions.solution: Since TP and TQ are tangents from external point T, angles OPT and OQT are each 90°. In quadrilateral OPTQ, the sum of angles = 360°. So ∠PTQ + ∠POQ + 90° + 90° = 360°, giving ∠PTQ = 360° − 120° − 180° = 60°. Alternatively, ∠PTQ + ∠POQ = 180° (supplementary), so ∠PTQ = 180° − 120° = 60°.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PA केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर बाह्य बिन्दु P से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा है। यदि ∠POB = 125° है, तो ∠APO बराबर है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA is a tangent from an external point P to a circle with centre O. If ∠POB = 125°, then ∠APO is equal to :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O is shown. From an external point P, a tangent PA touches the circle at A. Chord OB is drawn such that angle POB = 125°. The angle APO is to be found.
questions.solution: Since PA is a tangent, ∠OAP = 90°. In triangle OAP, ∠AOP = 180° − ∠POB = 180° − 125° = 55° (since OB is a straight line through O making ∠POB = 125°, so ∠POA = 180° − 125° = 55°). In triangle OAP: ∠OAP + ∠AOP + ∠APO = 180°, so 90° + 55° + ∠APO = 180°, giving ∠APO = 35°.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में केन्द्र O वाला एक वृत्त दर्शाया गया है। लघु त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल 7 cm² है। वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: Shown in the given figure is a circle with centre O. The area of the minor sector is 7 cm². Area of circle is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O is shown. A minor sector is marked with a central angle of 30° (sector OST). The area of this minor sector is given as 7 cm².
questions.solution: The minor sector has central angle 30°. Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr². So 7 = (30/360) × πr² = (1/12) × πr². Therefore πr² = 84. The area of the full circle = πr² = 84π cm². Wait — the sector area = (30/360)πr² = 7, so πr² = 7 × 12 = 84. But area of circle = πr² = 84, not 84π. Therefore the correct answer is option C: 84 cm². The area of the circle is 84 cm².

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, O वृत्त का केन्द्र है। XYZ वृत्त की एक चाप है, जो केन्द्र पर 45° का कोण अंतरित करती है। यदि वृत्त की त्रिज्या 32 cm है, तो चाप XYZ की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of circle. XYZ is an arc of the circle subtending an angle of 45° at the centre. If the radius of the circle is 32 cm, then the length of the arc XYZ is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O is shown. Arc XYZ subtends an angle of 45° at the centre. The radius is 32 cm.
questions.solution: Length of arc = (θ/360°) × 2πr = (45/360) × 2π × 32 = (1/8) × 64π = 8π cm. Wait: (45/360) = 1/8, and 2 × 32 = 64, so arc length = 64π/8 = 8π cm. The correct answer is option B: 8π cm.

questions.text: एक गोले का आयतन 36π cm³ है, तो उसकी त्रिज्या (cm में) है :
questions.text_english: The radius of a sphere (in cm) whose volume is 36π cm³, is :
questions.solution: Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³ = 36π. So r³ = 36π × 3/(4π) = 108/4 = 27. Therefore r = ∛27 = 3 cm. Options B, C, and D give incorrect values as cube root of 27 is exactly 3.

questions.text: यदि आँकड़ों के किसी समूह का माध्य 12 तथा बहुलक 21 है, तो उसका माध्यक है :
questions.text_english: If the mean and mode of a data are 12 and 21 respectively, then its median is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean. Substituting, 21 = 3 × Median − 2 × 12 = 3 × Median − 24. So 3 × Median = 45, giving Median = 15. Options A, B, and D do not satisfy this empirical formula.
questions.topic: Empirical Relationship between Mean, Median, Mode

questions.text: एक पांसे को एक बार फेंका जाता है। 3 के अलावा अन्य संख्या आने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: A die is thrown once. Probability of getting a number other than 3 is :
questions.solution: A die has 6 faces numbered 1 to 6. Numbers other than 3 are: 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 — that is 5 favourable outcomes. Probability = 5/6. Option A (1/6) is the probability of getting 3. Option B (3/6 = 1/2) and D (1) are incorrect.

questions.text: 960 और 432 का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) है :
questions.text_english: The HCF of 960 and 432 is :
questions.solution: Using prime factorisation: 960 = 2⁶ × 3 × 5 and 432 = 2⁴ × 3³. HCF = product of smallest powers of common prime factors = 2⁴ × 3 = 16 × 3 = 48. Options B (54 = 2 × 3³), C (72 = 2³ × 3²), and D (36 = 2² × 3²) are all incorrect as they are not the highest common factor of both numbers.

questions.text: प्राकृत संख्या 2 है :
questions.text_english: The natural number 2 is :

options.D: न तो भाज्य और न ही अभाज्य

questions.solution: A prime number has exactly two distinct factors: 1 and itself. The number 2 has exactly two factors — 1 and 2 — so it is a prime number. It is also the only even prime number. It is not composite (which requires more than two factors), and it is not neither, as it clearly satisfies the definition of prime.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : बहुपद p(y) = y² + 4y + 3 के दो शून्यक होते हैं।
तर्क (R) : एक द्विघात बहुपद (quadratic polynomial) के अधिकतम दो शून्यक हो सकते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : The polynomial p(y) = y² + 4y + 3 has two zeroes.
Reason (R) : A quadratic polynomial can have at most two zeroes.
questions.instruction_line: निर्देश : प्रश्न संख्या 19 और 20 अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न हैं। दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोड (a), (b), (c) और (d) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Directions: Question numbers 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Select the correct answer from codes (a), (b), (c) and (d).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु तर्क (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: p(y) = y² + 4y + 3 = (y+1)(y+3), which has two zeroes: y = −1 and y = −3. Reason (R) is also true: a quadratic polynomial is of degree 2, so by the fundamental theorem of algebra, it can have at most 2 zeroes. Furthermore, Reason (R) correctly explains why Assertion (A) holds — since p(y) is quadratic, it has at most 2 zeroes, and factorisation confirms exactly 2. Hence option A is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : अधिवर्ष (leap year) में 53 सोमवार आने की प्रायिकता 2/7 होती है।
तर्क (R) : सामान्य वर्ष (non-leap year) में 53 सोमवार आने की प्रायिकता 5/7 होती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : The probability that a leap year has 53 Mondays is 2/7.
Reason (R) : The probability that a non-leap year has 53 Mondays is 5/7.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is TRUE: A leap year has 366 days = 52 complete weeks + 2 extra days. These 2 extra days can be any of 7 pairs: (Sun,Mon), (Mon,Tue), (Tue,Wed), (Wed,Thu), (Thu,Fri), (Fri,Sat), (Sat,Sun). Monday appears in 2 of these pairs, so P(53 Mondays in leap year) = 2/7. Reason (R) is FALSE: A non-leap year has 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 extra day. The extra day can be any of 7 days, so P(53 Mondays) = 1/7, not 5/7. Hence Assertion is true but Reason is false, making option C correct.

questions.text: क्या बिंदु P (1, 0), Q (– 5, 0) और R (– 2, 5) एक त्रिभुज बनाते हैं? यदि हाँ, तो बने त्रिभुज का प्रकार बताइए।
questions.text_english: Do the points P (1, 0), Q (– 5, 0) and R (– 2, 5) form a triangle? If so, name the type of triangle formed.

key_points: Calculate all three side lengths using the distance formula
Since QR = PR, the triangle is isosceles

questions.solution: Using the distance formula: PQ = √((−5−1)² + (0−0)²) = √36 = 6. QR = √((−2−(−5))² + (5−0)²) = √(9+25) = √34. PR = √((−2−1)² + (5−0)²) = √(9+25) = √34. Since all three distances are non-zero and no single distance equals the sum of the other two, the three points form a triangle. Since QR = PR = √34, the triangle PQR is an isosceles triangle.

questions.text:
(A) यदि tan θ = 24/7, तो sin θ + cos θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) यदि cot θ = 7/8 है, तो (1 + sin θ)(1 − sin θ) / (1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(A) If tan θ = 24/7, then find the value of sin θ + cos θ.
OR
(B) If cot θ = 7/8, then find the value of (1 + sin θ)(1 − sin θ) / (1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ).

sub_questions.text: यदि tan θ = 24/7, तो sin θ + cos θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If tan θ = 24/7, then find the value of sin θ + cos θ.

key_points: tan θ = 24/7, hypotenuse = 25, sin θ = 24/25, cos θ = 7/25, sum = 31/25

sub_questions.solution: Given tan θ = 24/7, we have opposite = 24, adjacent = 7. By Pythagoras theorem, hypotenuse = √(24² + 7²) = √(576 + 49) = √625 = 25. Therefore sin θ = 24/25 and cos θ = 7/25. Hence sin θ + cos θ = 24/25 + 7/25 = 31/25.

sub_questions.text: यदि cot θ = 7/8 है, तो (1 + sin θ)(1 − sin θ) / (1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If cot θ = 7/8, then find the value of (1 + sin θ)(1 − sin θ) / (1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ).

key_points: Simplify using identities: numerator = cos²θ, denominator = sin²θ, result = cot²θ = 49/64

sub_questions.solution: Using algebraic identities: (1 + sin θ)(1 − sin θ) = 1 − sin²θ = cos²θ, and (1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ) = 1 − cos²θ = sin²θ. Therefore the expression = cos²θ / sin²θ = cot²θ = (7/8)² = 49/64.

questions.solution: This question has two options. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: दो संकेंद्रीय वृत्तों की त्रिज्याएँ 5 cm और 4 cm हैं। बड़े वृत्त की उस जीवा की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए जो छोटे वृत्त को स्पर्श करती है।
questions.text_english: Two concentric circles are of radii 5 cm and 4 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle.
questions.solution: Let O be the common centre. The chord AB of the larger circle is tangent to the smaller circle at point P. Since OP is perpendicular to AB (radius to tangent point), and OP = 4 cm (radius of smaller circle), OA = 5 cm (radius of larger circle). Using Pythagoras theorem in triangle OPA: AP = √(OA² − OP²) = √(25 − 16) = √9 = 3 cm. Since OP bisects AB, AB = 2 × AP = 2 × 3 = 6 cm.

questions.text: एक द्विघात बहुपद ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके शून्यक (5 − 2√3) और (5 + 2√3) हैं।
questions.text_english: Find a quadratic polynomial whose zeroes are (5 − 2√3) and (5 + 2√3).
questions.solution: Let the zeroes be α = 5 − 2√3 and β = 5 + 2√3. Sum of zeroes = α + β = (5 − 2√3) + (5 + 2√3) = 10. Product of zeroes = αβ = (5 − 2√3)(5 + 2√3) = 25 − 12 = 13. The required quadratic polynomial is p(x) = x² − (α+β)x + αβ = x² − 10x + 13.

questions.text:
(A) △ABC में, DE ∥ BC है। यदि AD = x, DB = x − 2, AE = x + 2 और EC = x − 1, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) ऊपर दी गई आकृति में, यदि △ABC ~ △XYZ, तो x और y के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(A) In △ABC, DE ∥ BC. If AD = x, DB = x − 2, AE = x + 2 and EC = x − 1, then find the value of x.
OR
(B) In the figure given above, if △ABC ~ △XYZ, then find the values of x and y.

sub_questions.text: △ABC में, DE ∥ BC है। यदि AD = x, DB = x − 2, AE = x + 2 और EC = x − 1, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC. If AD = x, DB = x − 2, AE = x + 2 and EC = x − 1, then find the value of x.
sub_questions.solution: By the Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT), since DE ∥ BC: AD/DB = AE/EC. Substituting: x/(x−2) = (x+2)/(x−1). Cross-multiplying: x(x−1) = (x+2)(x−2), which gives x² − x = x² − 4. Therefore −x = −4, so x = 4.

sub_questions.text: ऊपर दी गई आकृति में, यदि △ABC ~ △XYZ, तो x और y के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the figure given above, if △ABC ~ △XYZ, then find the values of x and y.
sub_questions.solution: From the figure, △ABC has sides AB = 4 cm, BC = 6 cm, AC = y, and △XYZ has sides XZ = 6 cm, YZ = 7.2 cm, XY = x. Since △ABC ~ △XYZ, AB/XY = BC/YZ = AC/XZ. Using BC/YZ = 6/7.2 = 5/6. Therefore AB/XY = 5/6, giving XY = x = 4 × 6/5 = 4.8 cm. Also AC/XZ = 5/6, giving y = 6 × 5/6 = 5 cm. So x = 4.8 cm and y = 5 cm. (Based on the given figure with AB = 4 cm, BC = 6 cm, YZ = 7.2 cm, XZ = 6 cm.)

questions.text:
(A) यदि x = h + a cos θ, y = k + b sin θ, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : ((x−h)/a)² + ((y−k)/b)² = 1
अथवा
(B) सिद्ध कीजिए : tan A/(1 + sec A) − tan A/(1 − sec A) = 2 cosec A
questions.text_english:
(A) If x = h + a cos θ, y = k + b sin θ, then prove that : ((x−h)/a)² + ((y−k)/b)² = 1
OR
(B) Prove that : tan A/(1 + sec A) − tan A/(1 − sec A) = 2 cosec A

sub_questions.text: यदि x = h + a cos θ, y = k + b sin θ, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : ((x−h)/a)² + ((y−k)/b)² = 1
sub_questions.text_english: If x = h + a cos θ, y = k + b sin θ, then prove that : ((x−h)/a)² + ((y−k)/b)² = 1

key_points: Substitute expressions to get cos²θ + sin²θ = 1

sub_questions.solution: Given x = h + a cos θ, so x − h = a cos θ, which gives (x−h)/a = cos θ. Given y = k + b sin θ, so y − k = b sin θ, which gives (y−k)/b = sin θ. Therefore ((x−h)/a)² + ((y−k)/b)² = cos²θ + sin²θ = 1, using the fundamental trigonometric identity. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए : tan A/(1 + sec A) − tan A/(1 − sec A) = 2 cosec A
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that : tan A/(1 + sec A) − tan A/(1 − sec A) = 2 cosec A

key_points: Take LCM, simplify numerator using sec²A − 1 = tan²A

sub_questions.solution: LHS = tan A/(1 + sec A) − tan A/(1 − sec A). Taking LCM = (1 + sec A)(1 − sec A) = 1 − sec²A = −tan²A. Numerator = tan A(1 − sec A) − tan A(1 + sec A) = tan A − tan A sec A − tan A − tan A sec A = −2 tan A sec A. LHS = −2 tan A sec A / (−tan²A) = 2 sec A / tan A = 2(1/cos A)/(sin A/cos A) = 2/sin A = 2 cosec A = RHS. Hence proved.

questions.solution: This question has two options (A) and (B). See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
(A) दी गई आकृति में एक समकोण △ABC दर्शाया गया है, जिसमें ∠B = 90°, AB = 4 cm तथा BC = 3 cm हैं। त्रिभुज ABC में बने अंतःवृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) दी गई आकृति में, यदि एक वृत्त △PQR की भुजा QR को S पर और बढ़ाई गई भुजाओं PQ और PR को क्रमशः M और N पर स्पर्श करता है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : PM = 1/2 (PQ + QR + PR)
questions.text_english:
(A) In the given figure, △ABC is a right triangle in which ∠B = 90°, AB = 4 cm and BC = 3 cm. Find the radius of the circle inscribed in the triangle ABC.
OR
(B) In the given figure, if a circle touches the side QR of △PQR at S and extended sides PQ and PR at M and N respectively, then prove that : PM = 1/2 (PQ + QR + PR)

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में एक समकोण △ABC दर्शाया गया है, जिसमें ∠B = 90°, AB = 4 cm तथा BC = 3 cm हैं। त्रिभुज ABC में बने अंतःवृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ABC is a right triangle in which ∠B = 90°, AB = 4 cm and BC = 3 cm. Find the radius of the circle inscribed in the triangle ABC.
sub_questions.solution: In right triangle ABC with ∠B = 90°, AB = 4 cm, BC = 3 cm. By Pythagoras theorem, AC = √(AB² + BC²) = √(16+9) = √25 = 5 cm. For a right triangle with legs a, b and hypotenuse c, the inradius r = (a + b − c)/2 = (4 + 3 − 5)/2 = 2/2 = 1 cm. Therefore the radius of the inscribed circle is 1 cm.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, यदि एक वृत्त △PQR की भुजा QR को S पर और बढ़ाई गई भुजाओं PQ और PR को क्रमशः M और N पर स्पर्श करता है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : PM = 1/2 (PQ + QR + PR)
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, if a circle touches the side QR of △PQR at S and extended sides PQ and PR at M and N respectively, then prove that : PM = 1/2 (PQ + QR + PR)

key_points: Use equal tangents from external points: PM = PN, QM = QS, RN = RS

sub_questions.solution: Since tangent lengths from an external point are equal: From P: PM = PN. From Q: QM = QS. From R: RN = RS. Now PM = PQ + QM = PQ + QS and PM = PR + RN = PR + RS. Adding both expressions: 2PM = PQ + PR + QS + RS = PQ + PR + QR (since QS + RS = QR). Therefore PM = (PQ + PR + QR)/2 = 1/2(PQ + QR + PR). Hence proved.

questions.image_description: Two figures: (A) Right triangle ABC with right angle at B, AB = 4 cm, BC = 3 cm, with inscribed circle. (B) Triangle PQR with a circle touching QR at S, and extended sides PQ and PR at M and N respectively.
questions.solution: This question has two options (A) and (B). See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: एक लंबवृत्तीय बेलन और एक लंबवृत्तीय शंकु के आधार बराबर हैं तथा ऊँचाईयाँ भी बराबर हैं। यदि उनके वक्रपृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात 8:5 है, तो उनकी आधार त्रिज्या तथा ऊँचाई के बीच का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A right circular cylinder and a right circular cone have equal bases and equal heights. If their curved surface areas are in the ratio 8 : 5, then find the ratio between the radius of their bases to their height.
questions.solution: Let radius = r and height = h. CSA of cylinder = 2πrh. Slant height of cone l = √(r² + h²). CSA of cone = πrl = πr√(r² + h²). Given ratio: 2πrh / πr√(r² + h²) = 8/5. So 2h/√(r² + h²) = 8/5, giving 10h = 8√(r² + h²). Squaring: 100h² = 64(r² + h²) = 64r² + 64h². So 36h² = 64r², giving r²/h² = 36/64 = 9/16. Therefore r/h = 3/4, so the ratio of radius to height is 3 : 4.

questions.text: दो भिन्न सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला जाता है। निम्नलिखित की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए : (i) कम से कम एक चित (head) आना। (ii) अधिक से अधिक एक पट (tail) आना। (iii) एक चित और एक पट आना।
questions.text_english: Two different coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting : (i) at least one head ? (ii) at most one tail ? (iii) a head and a tail ?

sub_questions.text: कम से कम एक चित (head) आना।
sub_questions.text_english: at least one head
sub_questions.solution: Sample space = {HH, HT, TH, TT}. Favourable outcomes (at least one H) = {HH, HT, TH} = 3. P = 3/4.

sub_questions.text: अधिक से अधिक एक पट (tail) आना।
sub_questions.text_english: at most one tail
sub_questions.solution: Favourable outcomes (at most one T, i.e., 0 or 1 tail) = {HH, HT, TH} = 3. P = 3/4.

sub_questions.text: एक चित और एक पट आना।
sub_questions.text_english: a head and a tail
sub_questions.solution: Favourable outcomes (exactly one H and one T) = {HT, TH} = 2. P = 2/4 = 1/2.

questions.solution: Sample space when two coins are tossed = {HH, HT, TH, TT}, total 4 outcomes. (i) At least one head: favourable = {HH, HT, TH}, P = 3/4. (ii) At most one tail: favourable = {HH, HT, TH}, P = 3/4. (iii) One head and one tail: favourable = {HT, TH}, P = 2/4 = 1/2.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Use proof by contradiction; assume √3 is rational, derive that 3 divides both p and q, contradicting coprimeness

questions.solution: Assume √3 is rational. Then √3 = p/q where p and q are integers with no common factor (i.e., HCF(p,q) = 1) and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 3 = p²/q², so p² = 3q². This means 3 divides p², and since 3 is prime, 3 divides p. Let p = 3m for some integer m. Then p² = 9m², so 9m² = 3q², giving q² = 3m². This means 3 divides q² and hence 3 divides q. But then 3 divides both p and q, contradicting HCF(p,q) = 1. Therefore our assumption is wrong, and √3 is irrational.

questions.text: वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें x-अक्ष, बिंदुओं (– 6, 5) और (– 4, – 1) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है। प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the ratio in which the x-axis divides the line segment joining the points (– 6, 5) and (– 4, – 1). Also, find the point of intersection.
questions.solution: Let the x-axis divide the segment joining A(−6, 5) and B(−4, −1) in ratio k:1. By section formula, y-coordinate of division point = (k×(−1) + 1×5)/(k+1) = (5−k)/(k+1). Since the point lies on x-axis, y = 0. So 5 − k = 0, giving k = 5. Ratio = 5:1. x-coordinate = (5×(−4) + 1×(−6))/(5+1) = (−20−6)/6 = −26/6 = −13/3. Point of intersection is (−13/3, 0).

questions.text:
(A) आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय (Basic Proportionality Theorem) का कथन लिखिए और सिद्ध कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) दी गई आकृति में, △ABC तथा △PQR की क्रमशः CM तथा RN रेखाएँ माध्यिका (medians) हैं। यदि △ABC ~ △PQR, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : (i) △AMC ~ △PNR (ii) △CMB ~ △RNQ
questions.text_english:
(A) State and prove Basic Proportionality Theorem.
OR
(B) In the given figure, CM and RN are respectively the medians of △ABC and △PQR. If △ABC ~ △PQR, then prove that : (i) △AMC ~ △PNR (ii) △CMB ~ △RNQ

sub_questions.text: आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय (Basic Proportionality Theorem) का कथन लिखिए और सिद्ध कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State and prove Basic Proportionality Theorem.

key_points: Statement: If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides, it divides those sides in the same ratio (AD/DB = AE/EC). Proof uses areas of triangles and equal heights.

sub_questions.solution: Statement: If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle intersecting the other two sides, then it divides the two sides in the same ratio. Given: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC, where D is on AB and E is on AC. To prove: AD/DB = AE/EC. Construction: Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB. Join BE and CD. Proof: Area(△ADE) = (1/2) × AD × EN. Area(△BDE) = (1/2) × DB × EN. So Area(△ADE)/Area(△BDE) = AD/DB. Similarly, Area(△ADE) = (1/2) × AE × DM and Area(△CDE) = (1/2) × EC × DM, giving Area(△ADE)/Area(△CDE) = AE/EC. Since △BDE and △CDE are on the same base DE and between the same parallels DE and BC, their areas are equal: Area(△BDE) = Area(△CDE). Therefore AD/DB = AE/EC. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC तथा △PQR की क्रमशः CM तथा RN रेखाएँ माध्यिका हैं। यदि △ABC ~ △PQR, तो सिद्ध कीजिए : (i) △AMC ~ △PNR (ii) △CMB ~ △RNQ
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, CM and RN are respectively the medians of △ABC and △PQR. If △ABC ~ △PQR, then prove that : (i) △AMC ~ △PNR (ii) △CMB ~ △RNQ

key_points: Use △ABC ~ △PQR to get side ratios, CM and RN are medians so AM = MB = AB/2 and PN = NQ = PQ/2, then apply SAS or SSS similarity

sub_questions.solution: Given △ABC ~ △PQR with CM median of △ABC (so M is midpoint of AB) and RN median of △PQR (so N is midpoint of PQ). Since △ABC ~ △PQR: AB/PQ = BC/QR = AC/PR = k (say), and ∠A = ∠P, ∠B = ∠Q, ∠C = ∠R. Since CM is median, AM = AB/2. Since RN is median, PN = PQ/2. So AM/PN = (AB/2)/(PQ/2) = AB/PQ = k. (i) In △AMC and △PNR: AM/PN = AC/PR = k (from similarity), and ∠A = ∠P. By SAS similarity, △AMC ~ △PNR. (ii) Similarly, BM = AB/2, QN = PQ/2, so BM/QN = k. In △CMB and △RNQ: BM/QN = BC/QR = k, and ∠B = ∠Q. By SAS similarity, △CMB ~ △RNQ. Hence both are proved.

questions.text: कक्षा X के 80 छात्रों द्वारा गणित के मॉक टेस्ट में प्राप्त अंक नीचे सारणी में दिए गए हैं। आँकड़ों का माध्यक और बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The marks obtained by 80 students of class X in a mock test of Mathematics are given below in the table. Find median and the mode of the data.
questions.image_description: A table showing cumulative frequency data (more than type): Marks 0 and above: 80, 10 and above: 77, 20 and above: 72, 30 and above: 65, 40 and above: 55, 50 and above: 43, 60 and above: 28, 70 and above: 16, 80 and above: 10, 90 and above: 8, 100 and above: 0.
questions.solution: First convert to class-wise frequency table: 0-10: 3, 10-20: 5, 20-30: 7, 30-40: 10, 40-50: 12, 50-60: 15, 60-70: 12, 70-80: 6, 80-90: 2, 90-100: 8. Total = 80. For Median: N/2 = 40. Cumulative frequencies: up to 40 = 37, up to 50 = 49. Median class = 40-50. Median = 40 + ((40−37)/12) × 10 = 40 + 30/12 = 40 + 2.5 = 42.5. For Mode: The class with highest frequency is 50-60 (f = 15). Modal class = 50-60, f₁ = 15, f₀ = 12, f₂ = 12, h = 10. Mode = 50 + ((15−12)/(2×15−12−12)) × 10 = 50 + (3/6) × 10 = 50 + 5 = 55. Therefore Median = 42.5 and Mode = 55.
questions.topic: Median and Mode of Grouped Data

questions.text: रेखीय समीकरणों के युग्म x − y + 2 = 0 तथा 4x − y − 4 = 0 का आलेख बनाइए। उन रेखाओं तथा x-अक्ष द्वारा घिरे त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Draw the graph of the pair of linear equations x − y + 2 = 0 and 4x − y − 4 = 0. Calculate the area of the triangle formed by the lines so drawn and the x-axis.

key_points: Intersection point (2, 4), x-intercepts at (−2, 0) and (1, 0), Area = 9/2 = 4.5 sq units

questions.solution: Equation 1: x − y + 2 = 0, so y = x + 2. Points: (0, 2), (1, 3), (−2, 0). Equation 2: 4x − y − 4 = 0, so y = 4x − 4. Points: (0, −4), (1, 0), (2, 4). Solving simultaneously: x − y + 2 = 0 and 4x − y − 4 = 0. Subtracting: 3x − 6 = 0, so x = 2, y = 4. Intersection point = (2, 4). x-intercept of line 1: y = 0 → x = −2, point (−2, 0). x-intercept of line 2: y = 0 → x = 1, point (1, 0). The triangle has vertices at (−2, 0), (1, 0) and (2, 4). Base = distance between (−2, 0) and (1, 0) = 3 units. Height = y-coordinate of (2, 4) = 4 units. Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 3 × 4 = 6 sq units. (Note: The base is along the x-axis and the perpendicular height from (2,4) to x-axis is 4, but the base is from x=−2 to x=1, which has length 3.) Area = 6 sq units.

questions.text:
(A) एक तेज़ चलने वाली ट्रेन 200 किमी की यात्रा के लिए धीमी चलने वाली ट्रेन से एक घंटा कम समय लेती है। यदि धीमी चलने वाली ट्रेन की चाल तेज़ चलने वाली ट्रेन से 10 किमी/घंटा कम है, तो दोनों ट्रेनों की चाल ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) दो वर्गों के क्षेत्रफलों का योग 640 वर्गमीटर है। यदि उनके परिमापों का अंतर 64 मीटर है, तो दोनों वर्गों की भुजाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(A) A faster train takes one hour less than a slower train for a journey of 200 km. If the speed of the slower train is 10 km/hr less than that of the faster train, find the speeds of the two trains.
OR
(B) The sum of the areas of two squares is 640 m². If the difference in their perimeters is 64 m, find the sides of the two squares.

sub_questions.text: एक तेज़ चलने वाली ट्रेन 200 किमी की यात्रा के लिए धीमी चलने वाली ट्रेन से एक घंटा कम समय लेती है। यदि धीमी चलने वाली ट्रेन की चाल तेज़ चलने वाली ट्रेन से 10 किमी/घंटा कम है, तो दोनों ट्रेनों की चाल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: A faster train takes one hour less than a slower train for a journey of 200 km. If the speed of the slower train is 10 km/hr less than that of the faster train, find the speeds of the two trains.

key_points: Faster train speed = 50 km/hr, Slower train speed = 40 km/hr

sub_questions.solution: Let the speed of the faster train = x km/hr. Then speed of slower train = (x − 10) km/hr. Time taken by faster train = 200/x hours. Time taken by slower train = 200/(x−10) hours. Given: 200/(x−10) − 200/x = 1. So 200x − 200(x−10) = x(x−10), giving 2000 = x² − 10x, or x² − 10x − 2000 = 0. Factorising: (x − 50)(x + 40) = 0. So x = 50 (rejecting x = −40 as speed is positive). Speed of faster train = 50 km/hr and speed of slower train = 40 km/hr.

sub_questions.text: दो वर्गों के क्षेत्रफलों का योग 640 वर्गमीटर है। यदि उनके परिमापों का अंतर 64 मीटर है, तो दोनों वर्गों की भुजाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of the areas of two squares is 640 m². If the difference in their perimeters is 64 m, find the sides of the two squares.
sub_questions.solution: Let sides of the two squares be a m and b m (a > b). Sum of areas: a² + b² = 640. Difference of perimeters: 4a − 4b = 64, so a − b = 16, giving a = b + 16. Substituting: (b+16)² + b² = 640. b² + 32b + 256 + b² = 640. 2b² + 32b − 384 = 0. b² + 16b − 192 = 0. (b + 24)(b − 8) = 0. So b = 8 m (rejecting negative value). Therefore a = 8 + 16 = 24 m. The sides of the two squares are 24 m and 8 m.

questions.solution: This question has two options (A) and (B). See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
एक ब्रूच चाँदी के तार से 35 cm व्यास के वृत्त के आकार में बनाई गई है। तार का उपयोग 5 व्यास बनाने में भी किया जाता है, जो वृत्त को 10 बराबर त्रिज्यखंडों में विभाजित करते हैं।

उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(i) वृत्त की त्रिज्या बताइए।
(ii) ब्रूच की परिधि बताइए।
(iii) (a) आवश्यक चाँदी के तार की कुल लम्बाई बताइए।
अथवा
(iii) (b) ब्रूच के प्रत्येक त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल बताइए।
questions.text_english:
A brooch is crafted from silver wire in the shape of a circle with a diameter of 35 cm. The wire is also used to create 5 diameters, dividing the circle into 10 equal sectors as shown in figure.

Based on the above information, answer the following questions :
(i) What is the radius of circle ?
(ii) What is the circumference of the brooch ?
(iii) (a) What is the total length of silver wire required ?
OR
(iii) (b) What is the area of each sector of the brooch ?

questions.text:
आलू दौड़ में, प्रारंभिक बिंदु पर एक बाल्टी रखी गई है, जो पहले आलू से 5 मीटर दूर है। शेष आलू एक सीधी रेखा में 3 मीटर के अंतराल पर रखे गए हैं, जबकि कुल 10 आलू हैं, जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है। एक प्रतियोगी बाल्टी से चलकर निकटतम आलू उठाता है और बाल्टी में डालने के लिए लौटता है, फिर अगला आलू उठाता है। यह प्रक्रिया तब तक चलती है जब तक सभी आलू बाल्टी में न आ जाएँ।

उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(i) पहला आलू उठाने और बाल्टी में डालने में तय की गई दूरी बताइए।
(ii) दूसरा आलू उठाने और बाल्टी में डालने में तय की गई दूरी बताइए।
(iii) (a) प्रतियोगी द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी बताइए।
अथवा
(iii) (b) यदि प्रतियोगी की औसत गति 5 मीटर/सेकंड है, तो सभी आलू बाल्टी में डालने में लगा औसत समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
In a potato race, a bucket is placed at the starting point, which is 5 m from the first potato. The other potatoes are arranged 3 m apart in a straight line, with a total of 10 potatoes, as shown in the figure. A competitor starts from the bucket, picks up the nearest potato, runs back to the bucket to drop it in, then returns to pick up the next potato. This process continues until all the potatoes are in the bucket.

Based on the above information, answer the following questions :
(i) What is the distance covered to pick up the first potato and drop it in bucket?
(ii) What is the distance covered to pick up the second potato and drop it in bucket?
(iii) (a) What is the total distance the competitor has to run?
OR
(iii) (b) If average speed of competitor is 5 m/s, then find the average time taken by competitor to put all the potatoes in the bucket.

sub_questions.text: पहला आलू उठाने और बाल्टी में डालने में तय की गई दूरी बताइए।
sub_questions.text_english: What is the distance covered to pick up the first potato and drop it in bucket?
sub_questions.solution: Distance to first potato = 5 m. Competitor goes and returns, so total distance = 2 × 5 = 10 m.

sub_questions.text: दूसरा आलू उठाने और बाल्टी में डालने में तय की गई दूरी बताइए।
sub_questions.text_english: What is the distance covered to pick up the second potato and drop it in bucket?
sub_questions.solution: Distance to second potato = 5 + 3 = 8 m. Competitor goes and returns, so total = 2 × 8 = 16 m.

sub_questions.text: प्रतियोगी द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी बताइए।
sub_questions.text_english: What is the total distance the competitor has to run?

sub_questions.text: यदि प्रतियोगी की औसत गति 5 मीटर/सेकंड है, तो सभी आलू बाल्टी में डालने में लगा औसत समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If average speed of competitor is 5 m/s, then find the average time taken by competitor to put all the potatoes in the bucket.
sub_questions.solution: Total distance = 370 m. Average speed = 5 m/s. Time = Distance/Speed = 370/5 = 74 seconds.

questions.text:
रेडियो टॉवरों का उपयोग रेडियो और टेलीविज़न सहित विभिन्न संचार सेवाओं को प्रसारित करने के लिए किया जाता है। टॉवर या तो स्वयं ऐंटेना के रूप में कार्य करता है या अपनी संरचना पर एक या एक से अधिक ऐंटेना को सहारा देता है। इसी अवधारणा पर आधारित, एक रेडियो स्टेशन का टॉवर दो खंडों 'A' और 'B' में बनाया गया था। टॉवर को बिंदु 'O' से तारों द्वारा सहारा दिया गया है (जैसा कि चित्र में दिखाया गया है)।

टॉवर के आधार और बिंदु 'O' के बीच की दूरी 6 मीटर है। बिंदु 'O' से खंड 'B' के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 30° है तथा खंड 'A' के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 60° है।

उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(i) बिंदु 'O' से खंड 'B' के शीर्ष तक तार की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
(ii) बिंदु 'O' से खंड 'A' के शीर्ष तक तार की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
(iii) (a) AB की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(iii) (b) △OPB का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Radio towers are used for transmitting a range of communication services including radio and television. The tower will either act as an antenna itself or support one or more antennas on its structure. On a similar concept, a radio station tower was built in two sections 'A' and 'B'. Tower is supported by wires from a point 'O' (as shown in figure).

Distance between the base of the tower and point 'O' is 6 m. From point 'O', the angle of elevation of the top of the section 'B' is 30° and the angle of elevation of the top of section 'A' is 60°.

Based on the above information, answer the following questions :
(i) Find the length of the wire from the point 'O' to the top of section 'B'.
(ii) Find the length of the wire from the point 'O' to the top of section 'A'.
(iii) (a) Find the distance AB.
OR
(iii) (b) Find the area of △OPB.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु 'O' से खंड 'B' के शीर्ष तक तार की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the wire from the point 'O' to the top of section 'B'.
sub_questions.solution: Let P be the base of tower, O the support point, distance OP = 6 m. Let B be the top of section B. tan 30° = PB/OP, so PB = 6 × tan 30° = 6/√3 = 2√3 m. Length of wire OB = OP/cos 30° = 6/(√3/2) = 12/√3 = 4√3 m.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु 'O' से खंड 'A' के शीर्ष तक तार की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the wire from the point 'O' to the top of section 'A'.
sub_questions.solution: Let A be the top of section A. Angle of elevation from O = 60°. Length of wire OA = OP/cos 60° = 6/(1/2) = 12 m.

sub_questions.text: AB की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance AB.
sub_questions.solution: Height of A (total tower height) = OP × tan 60° = 6√3 m. Height of B = OP × tan 30° = 6/√3 = 2√3 m. AB = PA − PB = 6√3 − 2√3 = 4√3 m.

sub_questions.text: △OPB का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the area of △OPB.
sub_questions.solution: In △OPB, OP = 6 m (base) and PB = 2√3 m (height, since ∠OPB = 90°). Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 6 × 2√3 = 6√3 sq m.
